rq-wr-01.front: What does Interior winter range look like?
rq-wr-01.back: Steep south and west faces, broken rock, shrubs, old Douglas fir, in the dry forest zone (85%).

rq-wr-03.front: Under what law are Ungulate Winter Ranges made?
rq-wr-03.back: Sections 9 and 12 of the Government Actions Regulation, Forest and Range Practices Act (90%).

rq-wr-04.back: Primary forest activities: timber harvest, silviculture, roads. Keep snow interception cover (99%).

rq-wr-05.front: Does a UWR order close hunting?
rq-wr-05.back: Not by itself. Hunting rules come from the synopsis (85%, my reading).

rq-wr-07.front: Dewdrop Rosseau Creek WMA is winter range for what?
rq-wr-07.back: Mule deer and California bighorn sheep (90%). Map C16: open lines only for vehicles.

rq-wr-08.front: Before hunting a conservation land or WMA?

rq-wr-09.front: Grazing lease with cattle on it?
rq-wr-09.back: No hunting without the consent of the lessee or occupant (99%, page 9).

rq-wr-10.front: Region 3 mule deer bucks from 1 November in your MUs?

rq-wr-11.back: No power boat, aircraft, motor vehicle or other machine to herd or harass wildlife (99%).

rq-wr-12.front: What disturbs wintering deer most, per agency fact sheets?
rq-wr-12.back: Dogs, then ATVs and mountain bikes, then people off trail (70%).

rq-wr-13.back: Each flight in snow costs fat and feeding time (70%).
